notablePrerequisites:
Zellix does not have summoning sickness.
Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Zellix by paying {1} and tapping it.
Haunted One triggers, causing all Horrors you control to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Zellix ability, causing a player to mill three cards.
If the player milled a creature card this way, Zellix triggers, creating a 1/1 Horror creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Pith Driller, adding {1}.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Pith Driller trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
